title: Vanishing of the first cohomology and the recovery of an invertible module from its direct image
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For a flat proper finitely presented family with f_*O_X = O_S, the lemma proves that the first cohomology of the structure sheaf vanishes and that an invertible module whose direct image is invertible of rank one is pulled back from the base. The proof establishes the vanishing by reducing to a computation on the fibres and then uses the resulting exactness of the direct-image sequence to identify the module with the pullback of its own pushforward. The identification of the pullback is the load-bearing step, since it requires the trace or norm construction together with the vanishing just proved. Retained author proof at lines 9453-9516.
